title: Are You for Us?
text: Are You for us or for our enemies?

title: Commander of the LORD's Army
text: Neither, | I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.

title: Holy Ground
text: Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.

title: Tightly Shut Up
text: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

title: Delivered into Your Hand
text: Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand …

title: Six Days
text: March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.

title: Seven Rams' Horns
text: Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark.

title: A Mighty Shout
text: … have all the people give a mighty shout. Then the wall of the city will collapse …

title: Not One Word
text: … do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout.

title: Once around the City
text: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once.

title: Back to the Camp
text: And the people returned to the camp and spent the night there.

title: They Did This for Six Days
text: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

title: Up at Dawn
text: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn and marched around the city seven times in the same manner.

title: The Seventh Day
text: Then on the seventh day, they got up at dawn …

title: The Only Day
text: That was the only day they circled the city seven times.

title: Shout!
text: Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

title: The Wall Collapsed
text: So when the rams’ horns sounded, the people shouted … and the wall collapsed.

title: Rahab Brought Out
text: So the young spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers, and all who belonged to her.

title: Her Whole Family
text: They brought out her whole family and settled them outside the camp of Israel.

title: Rahab Was Spared
text: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her …

title: She Lives among the Israelites
text: So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.

title: By Faith the Walls Fell
text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

title: The LORD Was with Joshua
text: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

title: Shut In
text: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites.

title: Not a Sound
text: Do not give a battle cry or let your voice be heard …
